I made no code changes in this repair pass. Neither failing check can pass whatever the code does, and `sh bin/test.sh` is still green (vet clean, `cli`, `logrecord` and `report` packages all pass; the gate exit shown is `tail`'s, since the pipe masks the script's own).

- **`log-required-fields-skip`:** the assertion calls `Path("internal/logrecord").read_text()`. I re-ran it and it still raises `IsADirectoryError`. `internal/logrecord` has to be a directory, because ARCHITECTURE puts the package there and `log-duplicates-first-kept` asserts `is_dir()` on the same path.
- **`log-decode-ignores-blank`:** the body is just `assert True`, so the harness excludes it as vacuous. The behaviour is covered by my own test, `TestReadIgnoresBlankLinesWithoutCountingThem`.

The behaviour behind `log-required-fields-skip` is covered by `TestReadSkipsRecordsMissingEachRequiredField`, which includes the missing-`job.target` case.
